lead_raw_text:
The structure of Rb2Y3 crystallizes in the trigonal space group R-3 (No. 143), with a unit cell containing 15 atoms (Rb6Y9) distributed over two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows both Rb and Y centers adopt close-packed-like local arrangements with 12 geometric neighbors each, with Rb surrounded by 9 Y and 3 Rb neighbors and Y surrounded by 6 Rb and 6 Y neighbors, spanning distances of 3.75–3.83 Å. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Rb- and Y-centered 12-vertex coordination polyhedra, as well as among like-centered polyhedra.
